tagline: Strike from wherever your adventurers stand, then rewrite the ending

featuredCards.title: Rising Action
featuredCards.caption: The cast walks on. An adventurer appears at The Narrator's side, then the whole party moves, and every new position is another doorway for the next attack.

featuredCards.title: Harrying Strike
featuredCards.caption: Surround them and the numbers climb. Three friends standing beside the target turn a humble 2 into an 8.

featuredCards.title: PLOT DEVICE: Red Herring
featuredCards.caption: Their chosen defence goes in the bin and their own deck picks the replacement. Whatever turns up first is what they block with.

featuredCards.title: Happily Ever After
featuredCards.caption: The final page. Win the fight and The Narrator heals for all of the damage, overkill included, so finishing off a sidekick pays out in full.
